description:
DECISION MADE (do not re-litigate promote-vs-remove): keep
benchbox/experimental/concurrency/, but RENAME it -- the name "concurrency"
is a misnomer. It is not the TPC spec concurrency (that lives in
core/throughput/). It is a load-testing + workload-analysis framework:
- patterns.py: WorkloadPattern shapes (Steady/Burst/RampUp/Spike/Step/Wave)
  -- time-varying demand profiles.
- executor.py: ConcurrentLoadExecutor -- drives a pattern, per-stream
  connections, dynamic concurrency targeting, background resource monitor.
- pool_tester.py: ConnectionPoolTester -- pool exhaustion / churn / under-load.
- analyzer.py: ConcurrencyAnalyzer -- queue-dwell, contention, scaling curves.

The package name collides conceptually with core/throughput and hides what the
code does. Rename to `benchbox/experimental/load_testing/` (recommended). The
class names already use the operative term ("ConcurrentLoad*", "Workload*"),
so only the package name and one analyzer class are actually misleading.

SCOPE: this item is a rename + honest re-documentation ONLY. It stays under
benchbox.experimental (unsupported, no stability guarantees, not wired into
the CLI/registry). Hardening and any decision to wire it into the CLI/UAT are
DEFERRED to a separate future item -- do not do that work here.

anti_patterns.instead: grep the whole repo for the old path after moving.
anti_patterns.why: coverage config and the joinorder test import it from outside the package dir

anti_patterns.dont: wire it into the CLI/UAT or 'harden' it here
anti_patterns.instead: capture that as a separate deferred item.
anti_patterns.why: this item is a rename only

deferrals.reason: Out of scope for the rename; revisit when there is time to invest in the feature.
deferrals.summary: Harden the framework and decide whether to wire it into the CLI/UAT as a supported load-testing mode

preserves.behavior: All existing tests still pass after the path/class updates.
Public class names ConcurrentLoadExecutor/Config/Result, the WorkloadPattern family, and the pool-tester types keep working (only the package path and ConcurrencyAnalyzer change).
The package stays under benchbox.experimental and remains unsupported/undocumented as a product feature (no CLI/registry wiring in this item).

prior_art.concept: README.md:41 and docs/usage/faq.md:20 — the prose that lists 'concurrency' as an experimental subsystem; update the name there too.
benchbox/core/throughput/ — the SPEC concurrency the old name collides with; the rename exists to disambiguate from this.
benchbox/experimental/concurrency/__init__.py — the public surface (__all__) whose internal import paths must be rewritten to the new package name.
benchbox/experimental/nl2sql/, gpu/, multiregion/, aiml_functions/ — sibling experimental subsystems; keep the same 'experimental package, unsupported' shape and README/FAQ treatment.
